Ana (partnerships): Quick sync — need to lock the SI co-sell handoff rules for the new Acme wave. Marketplace listing goes live next Tues. Who owns account stitching & lead pre-claim window?
Mike (sales-ops): I can take ownership for NA. Need a deterministic match process so reps don't double-claim. Proposal: 48h claim window from lead ingestion + overlap threshold > 0.8.
Jordan (si-engage): For SIs we prefer 'first-touch' claim with opt-in flags. Also flag marketplace leads as marketplace:true so we don't treat like inbound SDR.
Sam (revops): +1 on tags. Suggest the matching logic use normalized domains -> lookup existing account by domain, fallback to company_name fuzzy match. Quick sample: 
```
-- pseudo SQL
SELECT account_id FROM accounts
WHERE domain = lower(trim(:lead_domain))
OR similarity(company_name, :lead_company) > 0.85
ORDER BY case when domain_match then 0 else 1 end, similarity desc
LIMIT 1;
```
Lisa (field-acct-ops): For overlaps we need an escalation flow: if two owners claim same account within 7 days, auto-assign to field-acct-ops queue and notify both owners. Also, SI co-sell reserves 25% credit for SI until closed-won?
Ana (partnerships): We shouldn't hardcode credits here, but add to playbook. Also need clarity on handoff channel: suggested workflow: marketplace -> si-intake-bot -> si-triage -> owner claim. @si-intake-bot can you confirm?
si-intake-bot: Created triage ticket T-4583, added tag marketplace:acme-integrator, assigned to si-triage. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/T-4583
Mike (sales-ops): One more edge: existing customers with multiple subsidiaries — prefer account family mapping vs single domain. Proposal: prefer parent_account_id when match confidence between child accounts > 0.9.
Jordan (si-engage): Will add a short checklist for the SI to confirm (1) contacts introduced, (2) NDA if needed, (3) platform access needed. Drafted checklist below: 
```
SI handoff checklist:
- Confirm POCs: name/email/role
- Confirm primary cloud region + marketplace account id
- Confirm any compliance constraints
- Attach PoC convo thread
```
Sam (revops): Can we add a quick regex to clean domains? I can push a helper lib update.
```
function normalize(domain) {
  return domain.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'').split(':')[0];
}
```
Ana (partnerships): Let's agree. Action items: Mike -> finalize claim-window & credit gating by EOD Thursday; Jordan -> add SI checklist to playbook; Sam -> PR for normalize helper; Lisa -> escalation SOP draft. If no objections I'll add to confluence and kick a short working session Friday 10am PT. :calendar:
Mike (sales-ops): :thumbsup: sounds good.
Lisa (field-acct-ops): Friday 10 works for me.
Jordan (si-engage): I'll be there, pushing checklist now.
Sam (revops): PR ready by EOD Thurs, linking in thread.
Ana (partnerships): Perfect — thanks all. I'll update playbook and ping partners before the marketplace launch.
